assets.purpose: Original illustration, sampled through a fringe contour in Canvas to preserve original hair geometry.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG visual novel character sprite, idle_smile.
Input images: image 1 is the authoritative face / eye / hair / accessory identity reference; image 2 is the authoritative outfit and full character reference.
Create the same original character 1xc, an adult young woman catgirl, in the exact highly detailed soft Japanese anime illustration style of these reference sheets. The face must closely match image 1: horizontally elongated gentle amber-gold eyes, deep brown upper eyelids, rich honey irises with dark brown small oval pupils and luminous gold lower irises, fine individual lashes, a delicate small nose highlight, small closed mouth, rosy finely hatched cheeks, soft pointed chin. Do not simplify the eyes or make them round mascot eyes.
Hair: short fluffy messy bob, silky white roots fading to soft lavender ends, fine wispy layered curls and detailed hair strands, a curling ahoge, a thin central bang falling between the eyes and cheek-framing side locks. Large fluffy white cat ears with pink interiors and white tufts. White paw-shaped hair clip with pink pads on HER left side (viewer right). Black leather choker, small gold buckle and hanging gold cat bell.
Outfit: oversized cream cable-knit cardigan worn slightly off the shoulders, rich knitted detail, long sleeves covering hands like sweater paws, visible pink paw prints on the sleeves, lavender side ribbon lacing; opaque lilac camisole dress with frilled hem; long fluffy white tail curling up behind her on viewer right, lilac ribbon bow and gold bell near its tip.
Pose: relaxed standing, both hands tucked INSIDE the long sleeves and held together in front of her chest, shoulders slightly raised, gentle cosy pose. Gentle closed-mouth smile, eyes softly open looking at the viewer, light blush.
Composition: exactly one character, knees-up / mid-thigh crop, 1024 x 1536 portrait 2:3 canvas. Face almost frontal with only a slight three-quarter angle. Character horizontally centered. Ear tips at about 4% from top; both ears and all hair inside frame. Torso and tail fully visible, skirt ending above the bottom with a small portion of thighs visible at lower edge. Character occupies 90% of height and about 80% of width. This is the base sprite from which matching facial variations will be edited, so use a stable neutral head position.
Rendering: premium Japanese visual novel tachie, delicate warm colored linework, soft cel shading with subtle painterly highlights, pastel cream / white / lilac / pink palette. Faithful facial detail as reference, not 3D, not doll-like, not chibi. Soft frontal illumination from upper left. Absolutely transparent background, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow, no border, no text, no watermark.

assets.purpose: Blank facial skin and body / back hair.
assets.prompt: Production sprite layer extraction/edit of the supplied image, preserving its exact 1024x1536 canvas coordinates. Create the BASE LAYER of this same adult catgirl character. Keep the body, full opaque cream cardigan outfit, crossed sweater sleeves, skirt, neck, black choker/gold bell, tail, hair behind the head, side curls and back hair, both cat ears, head silhouette, hair clip, lighting and all colors absolutely identical. Make ONLY two changes: (1) remove the eyes, eyebrows, lashes, mouth and nose highlight, leaving smooth softly shaded blank facial skin with the same light pink cheeks; (2) remove ONLY the central front bangs that cross the forehead and overlap the central face, revealing natural blank forehead skin beneath. The side framing curls and all back hair stay unchanged. This intentionally faceless base is for compositing separate eye/mouth features and a foreground bangs layer in a game; it must have no eyes, no mouth, no eyebrows, no nose marks and no original central bangs remaining. Keep the face/chin shape and head angle exactly the same; no moving or resizing any body part. Transparent background, no scenery or shadow. Do not redraw the body or change the pose. Exactly registered with the input. The head tilt is as in the input.

Create a production transparent facial-feature sprite atlas for the adult catgirl in the supplied image. This is a technical 2D game compositing texture, not a character sheet. Output a 1024 x 1024 square PNG, true transparent alpha. Arrange EXACTLY 12 facial-feature sets in a precise 3-column x 4-row equal-cell grid, no margins between cells, no lines or labels. Each cell is 341.333 pixels wide and 256 pixels tall.
Draw ONLY each pair of eyes, matching eyebrows, tiny nose highlight, small mouth, and very delicate blush hatching on transparent pixels. NO skin fill, NO face oval, NO hair, NO head, NO ears, NO neck, NO body, NO background, NO text. Everything between and around these isolated facial features must be transparent.
Identity and rendering must EXACTLY match the supplied reference: elegant horizontally elongated slightly drooping anime eyes, warm dark chocolate fine lashes, amber/honey gold richly detailed irises with small dark oval pupils, luminous lower iris, tiny highlights, thin lilac-brown brows, extremely small understated mouth. No round mascot eyes.
Very important registration: the original face is tilted slightly counterclockwise as viewed, with its viewer-left eye lower than its viewer-right eye. Preserve this tilt in ALL cells, not an upright face. In EVERY cell: viewer-left eye centered at local (105,118), viewer-right eye at (240,87), tiny nose highlight at (171,146), mouth centered at (178,187). Eye pair size and positions must be absolutely constant across all expressions; open eye width approx 85 pixels and height approx 39 pixels, eyebrows approx 30 pixels above each eye. All facial details remain inside each cell with at least 15 pixels of clear edge.
Expressions in row-major order, left to right:
Row 1: (1) gentle closed-mouth smile, relaxed amber eyes open; (2) a gentle natural blink, both eyes closed, same small closed smile; (3) same open eyes as cell 1 with a small softly open speaking mouth.
Row 2: (4) cheerful closed crescent eyes and small happy open-mouth laugh; (5) blissful relaxed closed eyes and a tiny content smile with soft blush; (6) peaceful sleeping closed eyes and tiny parted mouth, no zzz.
Row 3: (7) cute pouting expression, narrow half-lidded amber eyes and subtle frown; (8) surprised but still elegant slightly wider amber eyes and tiny round open mouth; (9) sad pleading amber eyes with tiny teardrops at outer corners and small wavering mouth.
Row 4: (10) affectionate hopeful amber eyes looking up, gentle tiny smile and blush; (11) playful wink, viewer-right eye closed, same delicate open amber eye on left and tiny smile; (12) shy slightly averted amber eyes with warmer blush and tiny embarrassed smile.
Soft pastel warm linework, identical visual novel illustration quality to reference. Transparent feature decals only. The atlas will be placed on the original blank facial skin and under a separate foreground hair layer. Do not draw or reshape skin, hair or silhouettes.

composition: src/sprite-art.js calibrates feature positions, samples facial feature islands, and places the original fringe above the eyes. Talking and blinking reuse the unchanged feature channel.
